charge_port.notes: Canada: the 2025 XRT is the first Hyundai in Canada with a NACS port.

supercharger_access.notes: Estimated: Canada 2025 XRT has the NACS port (Guide Auto); Hyundai Canada FAQ confirms Supercharger access through the NACS port for 2026+ and does not name the 2025 XRT; Hyundai USA says the same native-NACS 2025 car uses Tesla V3/V4 Superchargers directly.

adapters_included.notes: Canada: US FAQ says the 25MY IONIQ 5 comes with a CCS adapter; the Hyundai Canada IONIQ 5 page says NACS-equipped models come with two CCS adapters (AC and DC). Canadian 2025 XRT not stated on a Canadian page for that year.
Hyundai Canada IONIQ 5 page (current model year): NACS-equipped IONIQ 5 models come with two CCS adapters (AC and DC).

wheels.notes: US XRT AWD used for the Canadian XRT; Canadian page not read.
